fields.label: Locations
fields.note: Checkbox name=location[]; slugs map to Bucharest, Romania / Poznan, Poland / Prague, Czech Republic / Warsaw, Poland. Verified live: location[]=warsaw-poland shows 1 of 9 positions.

notes: corporate.payu.com/careers/ redirects to the company's own WordPress job board, corporate.payu.com/job-board/. The board is server-rendered ('Showing 9 of 9 positions', no pagination, no AJAX) and filters through a GET form (action /job-board/, method get) with two checkbox groups: department[] and location[]. There is no keyword input, so keyword matching is local. Each row links to a PayU-owned /job/<uuid>/ detail page; jobs.lever.co/payugpo is only the apply destination and is not used for membership or filtering.
evidence: https://corporate.payu.com/job-board/ (GET form .filter--filters-list, checkboxes name=department[] and name=location[])
